Jordan — thanks for the recap and quick follow. A few clarifications from the security team so we can scope the export correctly:

Required fields for the evidence export: user_id (internal user/email), action (read/write/export/delete), target_resource (dataset/table/object), timestamp (UTC, ISO8601), IP_address, session_id, user_role, and the request_id/trace_id if available.
Retention: We have a compliance requirement for 7 years. Ideally we get confirmation that older logs are accessible and exportable (even if from cold/archive) and the process/time to retrieve archived logs.
PII: For any fields that contain PII (e.g., resource names that may include customer identifiers), we need either a pseudonymized export or a clearly documented redaction process. We cannot accept exports that leak customer identifiers without explicit DPA language.
Chain-of-custody: Can you provide a manifest that includes a hash of the export and a signed attestation (who pulled it, when, for what purpose)? If you have a standard evidence package/process, please point us to it.

Target for the sample: Mar 6 works for a first sanitized sample. For the final export there will need to be a procurement request (procurement@) and an internal review — we can coordinate after we see the sample.

Thanks,
Sam Patel
Director, Security Compliance | FincoBank

Jordan/Marissa — here's what we can commit to and the open items we need to track: 

What we capture today (summary):
- user_id, action, target_resource, timestamp (ISO8601 UTC), IP_address, session_id, user_role, request_id/trace_id (for traced requests) — all captured in our request/audit pipeline.
- Exports: we can produce CSV or newline-delimited JSON exports with configurable column selection. Timestamps include timezone (UTC) and we include request_id for traceability.

Retention & retrieval: 
- Hot store (queryable): default 90 days for production hosted logs.
- Warm/archived: we retain compressed archives for 2 years in our standard archival tier and can retain up to 7 years on customer request under an archive policy (additional storage/retention add-on or enterprise contract required).
- Retrieval time for archived slices: typically 24-72 hours depending on scope; full 7-year restores may take longer and require coordination.

PII handling & redaction:
- We can produce sanitized exports that pseudonymize or redact fields before export. For example, we can hash or token-map resource identifiers and include a mapping table under controlled access if needed by compliance.
- Note: redaction/pseudonymization is irreversible unless you keep a mapping; storing mapping has its own controls. We need to agree on the approach with Finco's security team.

Chain-of-custody & attestation:
- We can provide a manifest file containing file-level SHA256 hashes and a signed attestation (signed by Redwood Security) that lists generation timestamp, requesting contact, and a brief purpose. 
- For formal legal evidence we recommend a hashed bundle + signed attestation and time-stamped logs from our S3 export process.

Deliverables & timeline:
- Sanitized sample export (CSV) with the requested fields: target date Mar 6 (3 business days).
- Manifest + attestation to accompany sample.
- If Finco requires 7-year archived extracts, we'll need to scope and price the archival retrieval + storage add-on; procurement should coordinate.

Next steps for us: I'll prepare a sanitized sample and manifest and upload to a secure S3 share for review by EOD Mar 6. Jordan — please confirm we have permission to share the sample S3 link directly with Sam/Alice/procurement@fincobank.com.
